title: The Kamajors, a civil defense group in Sierra Leone, played a crucial role in supporting the Ecomog peacekeeping force during the struggle to restore President Ahmed Tejan Kabbah's elected government. Initially formed as hunters and protectors of their communities, the Kamajors transformed into a formidable fighting force against the junta and its Revolutionary United Front (RUF) allies. Their legendary campaigns, particularly the 'Black December' offensive, significantly weakened the junta, leading to its eventual downfall. As peace returns to Sierra Leone, the Kamajors face the challenge of redefining their role in society after their heroic contributions to democracy.
